@graph.description: Hawthorn (Crataegus monogyna and related species) is a hedgerow shrub whose leaves, flowers, and berries are rich in oligomeric procyanidins and flavonoids. Standardized extracts have been studied as an add-on for chronic heart failure: a Cochrane meta-analysis of randomized trials reported that hawthorn extract, used alongside conventional treatment, improved exercise tolerance and symptoms such as shortness of breath and fatigue. The trials were short, and hawthorn is not a substitute for prescribed heart-failure therapy; anyone with heart disease should use it only under medical supervision.
